numbersIntro: The activity period changes recent events. Current totals remain current.
membersDefinition: All member records in this workspace, including inactive and retained anonymized records, as in Insights. Joined uses the join date, or creation date when missing.
rewardsDefinition: Currently fulfilled points-reward redemptions, counted by fulfillment time. Pending, approved and cancelled requests do not count. Insights’ redemption chart groups by request creation.
pointsDefinition: Active members’ recorded current balances, as in Insights. Includes negative corrections and points awaiting the expiry sweep. This is not qualification progress or cash.
offersDefinition: Recorded offer uses with a used status and use time in this period. Untracked discounts are not included.
activeOffersDefinition: Enabled offers valid on the venue date and below their total use cap. Individual member eligibility still applies.
visitsDefinition: Recorded qualifying visits, once per member per venue day, excluding reversed visits. Includes desk, booking and event visits.
benefitsDefinition: Currently fulfilled benefit requests, counted by fulfillment time. Approval alone does not count.
activeBenefitsDefinition: Enabled, non-deleted benefit definitions. Each member’s eligibility depends on their level and assignments.
periodDefinition: Uses the same calendar starts as Insights: 30 venue days, 13 Monday-based weeks, or the current month and 11 preceding months. Future events are excluded.
unavailableValue: Unavailable values appear as —, never as zero.
previewExplanation: An illustrative membership, using your current program. No member account or wallet pass is created.
previewQuestion: A clear answer at every step
useLine: Follow the reward’s terms and your team’s fulfillment instructions.
levelIncludesLine: Eligible benefits are shown separately from points rewards.
appearanceHint: Branding and the real member app are managed in Card & app.
exampleFoot: Illustrative preview · no points are spent
